description: Sensor-to-mount transforms for the V2 OV9782 stereo build (reference). Rotations are intrinsic Euler angles in the mount frame. Positions are lens/sensor center in mount frame. The code computes 4x4 T_sensor_to_mount matrices from these values.

camera_convention.note: OpenCV camera frame: +Z=optical, +X=right in image, +Y=down. The code applies a base rotation from OpenCV frame to body frame based on image_right and image_down fields.

camera_top.name: OV9782 #1 (index side)
camera_top.euler_description: -20deg yaw around Z (from +Y toward +X), then -5deg pitch around body X (down). Measured in Fusion 360 2026-02-28.
camera_top.image_orientation_note: Verified 2026-03-01: optical flow on session_084235 shows +X_mount motion -> scene moves left in image (du=-812px), confirming image_right = +X

camera_bot.name: OV9782 #2 (3-finger side)
camera_bot.euler_description: No yaw, -45deg pitch around X (pointing down into workspace)
camera_bot.image_orientation_note: Verified 2026-03-01: optical flow on session_084235 confirms same orientation as cam_top (du=-1554px)

tof_top.name: VL53L1X #1 (index side, forward+up)
tof_top.euler_description: -20deg yaw around Z (same as cam_top), then +15deg pitch around body X (up, opposite of cam_top)
tof_top.viewing_direction_note: Same yaw as camera_top but pitched UP instead of down

tof_bot.name: VL53L1X #2 (3-finger side)
tof_bot.euler_description: -45deg pitch around X (down, same as cam_bot), then -15deg yaw around body Z

imu.name: ICM-20948 (MCU-20948 breakout)
imu.note: T_imu_to_mount derived from Kalibr cam0 T_cam_imu (ICM-20948) + CAD T_cam0_to_mount (2026-03-17). Axis mapping: X_imu->+Y_mount, Y_imu->+Z_mount, Z_imu->+X_mount.
